items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: my Sean on Friday, she'd bring these big fish heads back

ctx.x: It was, it was fish heads. And you get, my mama used to bring them back from, when she, my Sean on Friday, she'd bring these big fish heads back. Right. And she'd cook them down with a tomato gravy. And boy, it was good. Now, you don't hear talk, now that's another dish I like, but you don't hear talk of fish cuvillon. And this was every Friday at fish cuvillon. But it was greens, you know, uh, turnip, turnip, see turnips, smothered down in greens. And I still like spinach. Uh, on Sundays was when you had…
Did, um, were there any special occasions where you would, where your mother would, did you ever buy you any special clothes for a special occasion? I had a pair of shoes.
